details: A preliminary ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran, announced on June 15 and discussed at the G7 summit, has significantly impacted global financial markets. This geopolitical de-escalation, which aims to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and lift the US naval blockade on Iranian ports, led to a surge in Bitcoin, briefly touching above $67,000. Oil prices also tumbled below $80 a barrel, easing broader inflation concerns. The formal signing of the deal is anticipated on June 19 in Switzerland.
title: US-Iran Deal Propels Bitcoin Rally, Calms Oil Markets
